OPENALEX_API_KEY.purpose: Search scholarly works, authors, and sources via OpenAlex.
OPENALEX_API_KEY.without: OpenAlex requires a key since 2026-02-13; anonymous requests return HTTP 503.

name: openalex_literature_search
description: Search for academic literature using OpenAlex. Supports optional full-text-index filtering (has_fulltext + fulltext.search) when you need body-only term discovery, but note: OpenAlex full-text indexing is incomplete, and a work can be open-access elsewhere (e.g., PMC) while still having has_fulltext=false in OpenAlex. Returns paper metadata and (when available) OA links/content URLs.

search_keywords.description: Keywords to search for in paper titles/abstracts/etc. For full-text-index-only matching, also use require_has_fulltext/fulltext_terms.

query.description: Alias for `search_keywords` (recommended when you standardize on `query` across multiple paper-search tools).

max_results.description: Maximum number of papers to retrieve (default: 10, maximum: 200).

year_from.description: Start year for publication date filter (e.g., 2020). Optional parameter to limit search to papers published from this year onwards.

year_to.description: End year for publication date filter (e.g., 2023). Optional parameter to limit search to papers published up to this year.

open_access.description: Filter for open access papers only. Set to true for open access papers, false for non-open access, or omit for all papers.

require_has_fulltext.description: If true, filters to works where OpenAlex indicates a full-text index is available (has_fulltext:true).

fulltext_terms.description: Optional list of terms that must occur in OpenAlex full-text index (adds fulltext.search:<term> filters and implicitly enables require_has_fulltext).

oneOf.description: List of academic papers from OpenAlex matching the search query

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the paper

pdf_url.description: URL to PDF if available, or null if not available

keywords.description: List of keywords/concepts associated with the paper, or 'Keywords not available' if none

url.description: URL to the paper (DOI if available, otherwise OpenAlex ID)

data_quality.description: Data quality indicators for the paper

has_abstract.description: Whether the paper has an abstract

has_citation_count.description: Whether citation count is available and greater than 0

name: openalex_search_works
description: Search OpenAlex works. Basic page mode exposes only the first 10,000 matches and reports that window in metadata. For complete deep retrieval, pass cursor='*' initially and continue with metadata.next_cursor. Full-text filters only match works indexed by OpenAlex and can miss full text available elsewhere.

search.description: Search query for works. Use filter + fulltext_terms/require_has_fulltext when you need full-text-index-only matching.

query.description: Alias for `search` (recommended when you standardize on `query` across multiple paper-search tools).

require_has_fulltext.description: If true, appends OpenAlex filter has_fulltext:true (keeps only works with full-text index available).

fulltext_terms.description: Optional list of terms to match in OpenAlex full-text index. Adds one or more fulltext.search:<term> filters and implicitly enables require_has_fulltext.

cursor.description: Official deep-pagination cursor. Start with '*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor; when set, page is omitted.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool. If omitted, ToolUniverse uses a default.

meta.description: Result count, paging, and OpenAlex's own notice about the request

notice.description: OpenAlex's own message about the request. Without an API key it says the caller shares one free $0.10/day budget with everyone on the same network IP, and how to get a key - which is why a tool returning it matters operationally

cost_usd.description: What this request cost against that budget

oql.description: The query in OpenAlex Query Language

oqo.description: The parsed query object, including the filters actually applied

url.description: The upstream URL the query became

order_default.description: Whether that order was the default

is_retracted.description: Whether the work has been retracted. A literature result that does not say this can be cited in good faith after it has been withdrawn

is_paratext.description: True for front matter, covers and editorial apparatus rather than a paper

has_fulltext.description: Whether OpenAlex has indexed the full text, as against the abstract only

open_access.description: Open access status and where to read it

oa_status.description: gold, green, hybrid, bronze or closed

any_repository_has_fulltext.description: Whether any repository holds the full text

best_oa_location.description: One place the work can be read, with its source and licence

is_oa.description: Whether this location is open access

landing_page_url.description: Page for the work at this location

pdf_url.description: Direct PDF link, when one is known

license.description: Licence at this location, e.g. cc-by

source.description: The journal or repository hosting this location

type.description: journal, repository, conference, book-series or ebook-platform

is_oa.description: Whether the source itself is fully open access

is_core.description: Whether OpenAlex treats it as a core source

host_organization.description: OpenAlex id of the publisher or institution

id.description: OpenAlex id for the location record

doi.description: DOI at this location, when it differs from the work's

is_accepted.description: Whether this is at least the accepted version

is_published.description: Whether this is the published version

raw_source_name.description: Source name as the metadata gave it

raw_type.description: Location type as the metadata gave it

primary_location.description: One place the work can be read, with its source and licence

is_oa.description: Whether this location is open access

landing_page_url.description: Page for the work at this location

pdf_url.description: Direct PDF link, when one is known

license.description: Licence at this location, e.g. cc-by

source.description: The journal or repository hosting this location

type.description: journal, repository, conference, book-series or ebook-platform

is_oa.description: Whether the source itself is fully open access

is_core.description: Whether OpenAlex treats it as a core source

host_organization.description: OpenAlex id of the publisher or institution

id.description: OpenAlex id for the location record

doi.description: DOI at this location, when it differs from the work's

is_accepted.description: Whether this is at least the accepted version

is_published.description: Whether this is the published version

raw_source_name.description: Source name as the metadata gave it

raw_type.description: Location type as the metadata gave it

locations.description: Every known location for the work

items.description: One place the work can be read, with its source and licence

is_oa.description: Whether this location is open access

landing_page_url.description: Page for the work at this location

pdf_url.description: Direct PDF link, when one is known

license.description: Licence at this location, e.g. cc-by

authorships.description: Authors in order, each with affiliation, country and ORCID where known

is_corresponding.description: Whether this author is a corresponding author

raw_author_name.description: The name as printed on the paper

institutions.description: Institutions for this author on this work

countries.description: Country codes for this author's institutions

corresponding_author_ids.description: OpenAlex ids of the corresponding authors

corresponding_institution_ids.description: OpenAlex ids of the corresponding institutions

ids.description: The work's identifiers in other systems: this is how an OpenAlex hit becomes a PubMed or PMC lookup

pmcid.description: PubMed Central URL carrying the PMCID

mesh.description: MeSH terms, each with its descriptor, qualifier and whether it is a major topic

concepts.description: OpenAlex concepts with scores (the older concept scheme)

primary_topic.description: The single best-matching topic, with the subfield, field and domain above it

sustainable_development_goals.description: UN SDGs the work relates to, with scores

study_designs.description: Study designs OpenAlex detected, where it does

referenced_works.description: OpenAlex ids of the works this one cites

related_works.description: OpenAlex ids of works OpenAlex considers related

fwci.description: Field-weighted citation impact: 1.0 is the field and year average

citation_normalized_percentile.description: Where the work sits in its field and year by citations

is_in_top_1_percent.description: Top 1% for its field and year

is_in_top_10_percent.description: Top 10% for its field and year

cited_by_percentile_year.description: Citation percentile band within the publication year

relevance_score.description: Match score for the search query, when searching

funders.description: Funders OpenAlex recorded for the work

awards.description: Grant awards, with funder and award id where known

biblio.description: Volume, issue and page range, which a citation needs and the DOI does not give

type.description: Work type, e.g. article, review, preprint, book-chapter

publication_date.description: Full publication date, where publication_year gives only the year

indexed_in.description: Which indexes hold the work, e.g. crossref, pubmed

abstract_inverted_index.description: The abstract as an inverted index: each word maps to its positions. OpenAlex does not ship abstracts as plain text, so a caller wanting the abstract has to rebuild it from this

apc_list.description: List article processing charge, where known

has_content.description: Which content OpenAlex holds for the work

content_urls.description: URLs for content OpenAlex holds, keyed by content kind

is_traditional.description: Whether the work is a traditional journal publication

volume.description: Volume, where OpenAlex sets it outside biblio

name: openalex_get_work
description: Get a single OpenAlex work (paper) by OpenAlex Work ID (W...). You can pass either the short ID (e.g., "W2626778328") or the full URL (e.g., "https://openalex.org/W2626778328").

openalex_id.description: OpenAlex Work ID (W...) or full OpenAlex URL.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

abstract_inverted_index.description: The abstract as a word -> positions map rather than text. OpenAlex stores it this way for licensing reasons; reconstruct by sorting the positions.

authorships.description: Each author with their position (first/middle/last), institutions, country and whether they are a corresponding author. The authorship record, which a citation needs.

awards.description: The grants behind the work, each with its id and award number. What links a paper to a funding record.

best_oa_location.description: The best open-access copy OpenAlex knows of: landing page, PDF url, licence and version. How to actually read the paper.

biblio.description: Volume, issue, first_page and last_page. The parts of a citation the DOI does not carry.

cited_by_count.description: Total citations OpenAlex has counted, e.g. 136007.

concepts.description: OpenAlex concepts for the work with their scores - what the paper is about, as the index sees it.

content_urls.description: URLs for the fetched content OpenAlex holds: pdf and grobid_xml.

countries_distinct_count.description: How many countries the authors span.

counts_by_year.description: Citations per year, each {year, cited_by_count}. A total hides whether a work is still being cited; this does not.

created_date.description: When OpenAlex created the record, ISO 8601.

funders.description: Funding organisations, each with its OpenAlex id and name.

has_content.description: Whether OpenAlex holds that content, per format.

institutions_distinct_count.description: How many institutions the authors span.

has_fulltext.description: Whether OpenAlex holds the full text, which is what makes text mining possible.

ids.description: The work's identifiers in one block: openalex, doi, mag, pmid where known. The join to every other literature source.

indexed_in.description: Which indexes list the work, e.g. ['arxiv', 'crossref'].

is_paratext.description: True for front matter, errata, tables of contents - things that are indexed as works but are not papers. Counting them as results inflates any literature survey.

is_retracted.description: True when the work has been retracted. A literature tool that does not say this can hand back a retracted paper as evidence, and nothing in the record would show it.

is_traditional.description: OpenAlex's flag for a conventionally published work.

keywords.description: Keywords OpenAlex assigns, each with an id and score.

language.description: Language code of the work, e.g. 'en'.

locations.description: Every copy OpenAlex knows of, including repositories and preprint servers.

open_access.description: Open-access status: is_oa, oa_status (gold/green/hybrid/bronze/closed) and the url. 'oa_status' is what says whether the full text can legally be read.

primary_location.description: Where the work was published: the source, its landing page, pdf url, licence and version.

primary_topic.description: The highest-scoring topic, with its score and its place in the subject hierarchy.

referenced_works.description: OpenAlex ids of the works this one cites.

related_works.description: OpenAlex ids of works it resembles, by OpenAlex's own similarity.

topics.description: OpenAlex topics with their subfield, field and domain. The current classification, which supersedes `concepts`.

type.description: Work type, e.g. 'preprint', 'article', 'review'. A preprint has not been peer reviewed, and the title does not say so.

name: openalex_get_work_by_doi
description: Get a single OpenAlex work (paper) by DOI. Provide a DOI string like "10.65215/2q58a426" (you can also pass a DOI URL like "https://doi.org/10.65215/2q58a426").

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

return_schema.description: OpenAlex work data from DOI lookup.

name: openalex_search_authors
description: Search OpenAlex authors. Basic page mode exposes only the first 10,000 matches; for complete deep retrieval, start with cursor='*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor.

search.description: Author name search query. Example: "Yann LeCun".

cursor.description: Official deep-pagination cursor. Start with '*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

name: openalex_get_author
description: Get a single OpenAlex author by Author ID (A...). You can pass either the short ID (e.g., "A5001226970") or the full URL (e.g., "https://openalex.org/A5001226970").

author_id.description: OpenAlex Author ID (A...) or full OpenAlex URL.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

name: openalex_search_institutions
description: Search OpenAlex institutions. Basic page mode exposes only the first 10,000 matches; for complete deep retrieval, start with cursor='*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor.

search.description: Institution name search query. Example: "Harvard University".

cursor.description: Official deep-pagination cursor. Start with '*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

name: openalex_get_institution
description: Get a single OpenAlex institution by Institution ID (I...). You can pass either the short ID (e.g., "I136199984") or the full URL (e.g., "https://openalex.org/I136199984").

institution_id.description: OpenAlex Institution ID (I...) or full OpenAlex URL.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

name: openalex_search_sources
description: Search OpenAlex sources (journals, conferences, repositories) by name or ISSN and return journal-level bibliometric metrics. Basic page mode exposes only the first 10,000 matches; for complete deep retrieval, start with cursor='*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor.

search.description: Source/journal name or ISSN to search for. Examples: "nature", "the lancet", "0028-0836".

cursor.description: Official deep-pagination cursor. Start with '*' and continue with metadata.next_cursor.

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

return_schema.description: OpenAlex sources search response. results[].summary_stats contains h_index, i10_index, and 2yr_mean_citedness.

name: openalex_get_source
description: Fetch the full OpenAlex source (journal) record by Source ID (S...) or by ISSN, returning journal-level bibliometric impact metrics: display name, ISSN-L and ISSNs, host organization (publisher), works_count, cited_by_count, is_oa / is_in_doaj open-access status, apc (article processing charges), and summary_stats with h_index, i10_index, and 2yr_mean_citedness (an impact-factor-like 2-year mean citedness). Resolve a journal name to its Source ID first using openalex_search_sources. You may also pass an ISSN directly as the source_id (OpenAlex accepts issn:0028-0836).

source_id.description: OpenAlex Source ID (e.g. 'S137773608'), a full OpenAlex URL, or an ISSN expression (e.g. 'issn:0028-0836').

mailto.description: Optional contact email for OpenAlex polite pool.

return_schema.description: OpenAlex source record. summary_stats contains h_index, i10_index, and 2yr_mean_citedness.
